from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class RightOfUseAsset(BaseModel):
    """Information about the 'right-of-use assets' line item in a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company this financial report belongs to")
    company_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code if available, e.g., 300221")
    right_of_use_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount in yuan; None if the line is empty/not present")
    balance_date: str | None = Field(description="The balance sheet date, e.g., '2024-03-31'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    right_of_use_assets_list: list[RightOfUseAsset]
